Happy girlfriends day jaanu. It's already been more than one and a half months since we started dating or basically three months heheh, and through these three months you've never ever failed to be the amazing girlfriend you've always been. From the first time we started talking all the way till today, you've never left my side, always supporting me through my good and bad. It's super cute how you always support and celebrate my achievements like your own, like the days in India where you showed mama all my press releases. You've never fail to make me feel loved and make me feel like family even within your own. And you know as a person you're genuinely amazing and you really inspire me because you are one person I can truly relate to in the way you work with morals and basic mutual understanding, the way you treat others and overall the overall way you live daily life which is something I look upto and resonate with heavilyyy. I love the way you involve me in your daily life and how you treat me like baby while being super calm and loving towards me hehehe. You are one person I dreamed of having in my life since I was a child and I thank god everyday for making that dream come true by bringing you into my life. Every single time we meet or talk I always end up feeling calm and safe around you no matter how stressful or bad my day went, because at the end of the day you never let me feel alone, rather acknowledge that whatever we do would be together. Thank you for being the best partner and being THE person I can run to, and I would always choose you first over anyone else. I love you so muchh. I can write way more but I need to save some for our 2 month hehehehe.

— Your amazing boyfriend hehehhe
